```yaml
name: CockroachDB Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

concurrency:
  group: cockroachdb-tests-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17
          cache: maven

      - name: Cache Maven dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-maven-

      - name: Build and run CockroachDB tests
        run: mvn -B clean test -DenableCockroachDBTests=true

      - name: Upload coverage to Coveralls
        uses: coverallsapp/github-action@v2
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          path-to-lcov: target/site/jacoco/lcov.info
          flag-name: cockroachdb
          build-number: ${{ github.run_id }}
          parallel: true
```
